lines: Confinement, cleverness — before I go, Yuhei plays it smart, struggling, darling
Confinement, stop — I don't know a thing about it
The irony of the scraps of hope we pin on others
Something inorganic, the kind everyone wishes for
Like I want to start ahead of everyone — but I can't see what's coming
Nothing there — just one new request
Love unchanged, and on top of that, warning, warning
Nothing there — just one request for you
Pour in these taut, straining feelings
Playing innocently — my darling, full of hope and expectation
Smiling bravely — the pain, the pain fades away
Dying a pathetic death — even the bitter memories are gone
Hate it, hate it — the worst of it, crying, down I go
Love unchanged, picking up the warning, warning
Nothing there — just one request for you
Pour in these taut, straining feelings
